title: Critical: User Authentication ID Mismatch Prevents Data Display
description: User etan@heyman.net has complete progress data in Convex (30/31 lines completed, userSongProgress, lineProgress) but frontend displays no data due to authentication ID mismatch.
acceptanceCriteria: User etan@heyman.net can see their song progress on dashboard
User progress data (30/31 lines completed) displays correctly
All user-specific data (wishlist, vocabulary, practice history) shows up
Authentication system correctly maps authId to userId in database

technicalDetails.rootCause: Mismatch between authId in users table and userId in progress tables
technicalDetails.dataLocation: User data exists under userId: k572fk152njnp9g621kc64bq4x7zgbyt
technicalDetails.authLookup: Frontend auth system looking under different authId

impact: High - User cannot see any of their learning progress despite data being present
reproductionSteps: Observe empty state despite user having 30/31 lines completed in database
analysis: Confirmed via Convex dashboard inspection - all user data exists but frontend queries return empty due to ID mismatch in user lookup logic
